end.summary:
Pari practised naming common non-metals and classifying them as solids or gases.
They identified oxygen and nitrogen as gases, and carbon/graphite and iodine as solids.
They connected graphite with pencils, chlorine with water disinfection, and oxygen with medical use.
Teach-back was not passed; the lesson ended when Pari said they were tired.
end.parentNote: Asha practised recall through everyday examples and repeated classification questions. Pari correctly connected graphite to pencils, chlorine to water disinfection, and oxygen to breathing and medical support. No factual mix-up was recorded; oxygen as a gas and its presence in air were stated again later. At home, ask Pari to sort five non-metals into solid, liquid, or gas and name one use for each.
